project.model_title: ES26-075 Plot 1, The Rectory, Bates Hill, Ightham TN15 9BG - Quotation A

views.title: Ground floor slab
views.desc: The ground-bearing slab inside the ICF (75 screed / 150 PIR / 150 RC / 150 hardcore; GF FFL = slab + 225) with the thickened RC edge the ICF starts on - no footing blocks. Indicative: engineer / SAP to confirm.

views.title: Ground floor walls, windows, doors and partitions
views.desc: Nudura 6in XR35, 6 courses (0 - 2,743) straight off the slab, fitted to Nudura Bond with no stack joints: the two front bays and the rear kitchen bay open on 3 sides - voids through the ICF, glazed corner to corner, the ICF band over carried on SHS steel posts at the corners (by others), door thresholds at FFL (+225) and every opening, with the dark grey casement windows and glazed doors fitted; the two load-bearing block walls (by others), the timber stud partitions, the chimney (by others) and the porch canopy.

views.title: First floor, steels and stairs
views.desc: PS10 metal-web joists spanning front to rear on ICF ledgers, block-wall hangers and four indicative steels over the bay mouths and the hall; the stair opening with its glass guard and the stacked timber stairs. Engineer to design.

views.title: First floor walls, gables, partitions and the second floor
views.desc: Courses 7 - 12 to the wall plate (5,486; the catslide wall stops at 10.5 courses under the low eaves), the right front gable raked at 45 degrees and the left gable on the bay-front line with returns over the wings (as ICF Supplies), raked to the verge and flat at 15 courses under its half-hip; the first-floor windows, the stud partitions (three load-bearing) and the room-in-roof floor.

views.title: Roof structure and the room in the roof
views.desc: Cut roof, 45 degrees, plain tiles: C24 rafters @600, hips and valleys to a flat crown, the half-hipped left gable, the rear hipped dormer and ten trimmed VELUX roof windows; the second-floor stud partitions raked to the rafters. Indicative - engineer to design.
